description: START KEY ... WITH LENGTH phrase (variable-length key comparison), ISO 14.9.41.2 prints it as `[ WITH LENGTH arithmetic-expression-1 ]` - provisional 2002 edge. Gated on RECOGNITION in the VersionConformancePass parse arm (VisitStartWithLength -> 0900 below 2002); startKeyPhrase carries no version predicate, so an ill-organized or unbindable START still names the edition (kb/Work PB353).
display: the START KEY … WITH LENGTH phrase
citation: ISO §2023:14.9.41.2 (provisional 2002 edge) — the printed [ WITH LENGTH arithmetic-expression-1 ] bracket; §2023:14.9.41.3 SR8 confines it to indexed organization
vcr: provisional 2002 edge (decision-1 policy); W1.5 parse-layer mapping (DEVLOG 594)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. W15P.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT F2 ASSIGN TO "f2.dat"
        ORGANIZATION INDEXED ACCESS DYNAMIC RECORD KEY RK.
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD F2.
01 R2.
   05 RK PIC X(5).
   05 RD2 PIC X(5).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    START F2 KEY = RK WITH LENGTH 3.
    STOP RUN.
